description: This PHP source file defines the Goteo\Console\UsersSend class, which manages sending various email notifications related to projects, including owner notifications, consultant notifications, investor updates, and project status alerts within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: UsersSend
classes.description: A controller class responsible for sending various email notifications related to projects, including owner updates, consultant alerts, investor updates, and project status notifications within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Sets the static URL used in email templates.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the current URL, defaulting to SITE_URL if not set.

methods.name: setConsultants
methods.description: Sets the default list of consultants.

methods.name: toOwner
methods.description: Sends email notifications to project owners based on different event types, substituting variables in email templates.

methods.name: toConsultants
methods.description: Sends email notifications to project consultants based on different event types, with variable substitution.

methods.name: toInvestors
methods.description: Sends email notifications to investors about project updates or status changes, including sharing post content.

methods.name: toFriends
methods.description: Deprecated method for notifying reward recipients; currently unused.
